ARISTOCRAT_STRIKE.title: Strike
ARISTOCRAT_DEFEND.title: Defend
ARISTOCRAT_TAXATION.title: Taxation
ARISTOCRAT_TAXATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain Gold equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
ARISTOCRAT_LINEAGE.title: Lineage
ARISTOCRAT_SUPERHUMAN.title: Superhuman
ARISTOCRAT_SUPERHUMAN.description:
Your Strikes and Defends can be upgraded [blue]1[/blue] additional time.{IfUpgraded:show:
Upgrade ALL Strikes and Defends in your hand for this combat.|}
ARISTOCRAT_VASSALS.title: Vassals
ARISTOCRAT_VASSALS.description:
For this combat, your Strikes and Defends upgrade whenever they are played.{IfUpgraded:show:
Your Strikes and Defends can be upgraded [blue]1[/blue] additional time.|}
ARISTOCRAT_RADIANCE.title: Radiance
ARISTOCRAT_RADIANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Gain a copy of this card.
ARISTOCRAT_EXPLOITATION.title: Exploitation
ARISTOCRAT_EXPLOITATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold.
ARISTOCRAT_SPUR.title: Spur
ARISTOCRAT_IRON_BLOOD.title: Iron Blood
ARISTOCRAT_IRON_BLOOD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Upgrade all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] in your hand for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_VERSATILE.title: Versatile
ARISTOCRAT_VERSATILE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Play all [gold]Defends[/gold] in your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_ESCORT.title: Escort
ARISTOCRAT_ESCORT.description:
Play all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] in your hand.{IfUpgraded:show:
Draw [blue]2[/blue] cards first.|}
ARISTOCRAT_CORONATION.title: Coronation
ARISTOCRAT_CORONATION.description: Upgrade all [gold]Strikes[/gold], [gold]Defends[/gold], and [gold]Innate[/gold] cards for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_CLASSIC.title: Classic
ARISTOCRAT_CLASSIC.description: Draw [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Defends[/gold] from your draw pile.
ARISTOCRAT_HONOR.title: Honor
ARISTOCRAT_HONOR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Can only be played if you have no Attack cards other than [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_INSPECTION.title: Inspection
ARISTOCRAT_INSPECTION.description: Draw a [gold]Strike[/gold] and a [gold]Defend[/gold] from your draw pile, and upgrade them for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_DIGNITY.title: Dignity
ARISTOCRAT_DIGNITY.description:
Whenever you play a [gold]Strike[/gold], gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]Defend[/gold], deal [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
ARISTOCRAT_ATTENDANT.title: Attendant!
ARISTOCRAT_ATTENDANT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] cost [blue]0[/blue].
ARISTOCRAT_PROTOCOL.title: Protocol
ARISTOCRAT_PROTOCOL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] in your hand gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_ANCESTRAL_BLOOD.title: Ancestral Blood
ARISTOCRAT_ANCESTRAL_BLOOD.description:
Exhaust a [gold]Strike[/gold] and a [gold]Defend[/gold] from your hand.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} for each card Exhausted.
ARISTOCRAT_EXTREME_PUNISHMENT.title: Extreme Punishment
ARISTOCRAT_EXTREME_PUNISHMENT.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Play every [gold]Strike[/gold] in your draw pile at random targets.
ARISTOCRAT_MAJESTY.title: Majesty
ARISTOCRAT_MAJESTY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
This turn, your [gold]Strikes[/gold] target ALL enemies.
ARISTOCRAT_GHOST_ARISTOCRAT.title: Ghost Aristocrat
ARISTOCRAT_GHOST_ARISTOCRAT.description: Next turn, your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] deal double damage and gain double [gold]Block[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_MANDATE.title: Mandate
ARISTOCRAT_MANDATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold].
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Upgrade ALL [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_GRANT.title: Grant
ARISTOCRAT_GRANT.description:
Add [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold] into your hand.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Add [gold]Ultimate Strike[/gold] into your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_HIT_AND_CUT.title: Hit and Cut
ARISTOCRAT_HIT_AND_CUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw a [gold]Defend[/gold] from your draw pile.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Transform a [gold]Defend[/gold] in your deck into [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_STRIKE_FOR_STRIKE.title: Strike for Strike
ARISTOCRAT_STRIKE_FOR_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs [blue]0[/blue] if you played a [gold]Strike[/gold] this turn.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Transform a [gold]Strike[/gold] in your deck into [gold]Ultimate Strike[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_REFORM.title: Reform
ARISTOCRAT_REFORM.description:
Draw X+1 cards.
Gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy for each [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold] drawn.
ARISTOCRAT_FAMILY_TREE.title: Family Tree
ARISTOCRAT_FAMILY_TREE.description:
Draw a [gold]Strike[/gold], a [gold]Defend[/gold], and a [gold]Perk[/gold] card from your draw pile.{IfUpgraded:show:
Upgrade them for this combat.|}
ARISTOCRAT_COMMAND.title: Command
ARISTOCRAT_COMMAND.description:
Draw [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] cards.
Play any [gold]Strikes[/gold] or [gold]Defends[/gold] drawn this way.
ARISTOCRAT_RAMPART.title: Rampart
ARISTOCRAT_RAMPART.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Transform all Status and Curse cards in your hand into [gold]Defends[/gold] for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_COOL_HEADED_BLOW.title: Cool-Headed Blow
ARISTOCRAT_COOL_HEADED_BLOW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
This turn, your [gold]Defends[/gold] cost [blue]0[/blue] but gain [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_EXTRAVAGANCE.title: Extravagance
ARISTOCRAT_EXTRAVAGANCE.description:
Lose up to [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold and gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Upgrade a random [gold]Strike[/gold] in your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_CALLING.title: Calling
ARISTOCRAT_CALLING.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Upgrade a random [gold]Defend[/gold] in your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_GREAT_LINEAGE.title: Great Lineage
ARISTOCRAT_GREAT_LINEAGE.description:
Gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Shuffle a [gold]Strike[/gold], a [gold]Defend[/gold], and a [gold]Wound[/gold] into your draw pile.
ARISTOCRAT_SILK_CURTAIN.title: Silk Curtain
ARISTOCRAT_SILK_CURTAIN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If this card is in your hand at the start of your turn, draw a [gold]Defend[/gold] and upgrade it.
ARISTOCRAT_HIGH_SOCIETY.title: High Society
ARISTOCRAT_HIGH_SOCIETY.description:
For this combat, your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] gain [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
Whenever a Strike or Defend is Exhausted, add a random Rare card into your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_EDICT.title: Edict
ARISTOCRAT_EDICT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose up to 2 Status cards in your draw pile and transform them into [gold]Strikes[/gold] for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_EDICT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose up to 2 Status cards to transform into [gold]Strikes[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_SELECTION.title: Selection
ARISTOCRAT_SELECTION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose any number of cards in your hand, transform them into [gold]Strikes[/gold] for this combat, then play them at random enemies.
ARISTOCRAT_SELECTION.selectionScreenProm: Choose any number of cards to transform into [gold]Strikes[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_MANDATORY_TAXATION.title: Mandatory Taxation
ARISTOCRAT_MANDATORY_TAXATION.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain Gold equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
ARISTOCRAT_ANCESTRAL_PRECEPTS.title: Ancestral Precepts
ARISTOCRAT_ANCESTRAL_PRECEPTS.descriptio: This combat, your [gold]Innate[/gold] cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less.
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_BLOOD.title: Golden Blood
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_BLOOD.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage, gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold.
ARISTOCRAT_BILLIONAIRE.title: Billionaire
ARISTOCRAT_BILLIONAIRE.description:
At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold.
The Gold gained by this effect decreases by [blue]1[/blue] each time it triggers.
ARISTOCRAT_PATRON.title: Patron
ARISTOCRAT_PATRON.description: At the start of each turn, spend [blue]5[/blue] Gold and gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_VANITY.title: Vanity
ARISTOCRAT_VANITY.description: Whenever you gain or spend Gold, deal [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
ARISTOCRAT_COLLECTION.title: Collection
ARISTOCRAT_COLLECTION.description:
Apply [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Whenever you deal attack damage to the target this turn, gain [blue]{MagicNumber2:diff()}[/blue] Gold.
ARISTOCRAT_INHERITANCE_TAX.title: Inheritance Tax
ARISTOCRAT_INHERITANCE_TAX.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for every [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold you have.
ARISTOCRAT_ESCORT_OUT.title: Escort Them Out
ARISTOCRAT_ESCORT_OUT.description:
Spend up to [blue]30[/blue] Gold.
Deal that much damage.
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_ARMOR.title: Golden Armor
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_ARMOR.description: Next turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] and Gold equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_TEA_TIME_INVITATION.title: Tea Time Invitation
ARISTOCRAT_IMMUNITY_PRIVILEGE.title: Immunity Privilege
ARISTOCRAT_PEASANTS.title: Peasants!
ARISTOCRAT_PEASANTS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and apply [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_TREASURED_SWORD.title: Treasured Sword
ARISTOCRAT_FORMAL_WEAR.title: Formal Wear
ARISTOCRAT_PROOF.title: Proof
ARISTOCRAT_PROOF.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deal [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] more damage for each other [gold]Innate[/gold] card in your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_BLUE_BLOODED.title: Blue-Blooded
ARISTOCRAT_BLUE_BLOODED.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Innate[/gold] card, gain [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] Gold.
ARISTOCRAT_PRIVILEGE.title: Privilege
ARISTOCRAT_PRIVILEGE.description: The first [gold]Innate[/gold] card you play each turn costs [blue]0[/blue].
ARISTOCRAT_LAW.title: Law
ARISTOCRAT_LAW.description:
Your [gold]Innate[/gold] cards have [gold]Retain[/gold].
Whenever an [gold]Innate[/gold] card is retained, its cost is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
ARISTOCRAT_TRUE_ANCESTOR.title: True Ancestor
ARISTOCRAT_TRUE_ANCESTOR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put all [gold]Innate[/gold] cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_LIGHT_AND_SALT.title: Light and Salt
ARISTOCRAT_LIGHT_AND_SALT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Give an [gold]Innate[/gold] card in your hand [gold]Retain[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_REFINEMENT.title: Refinement
ARISTOCRAT_REFINEMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put an [gold]Innate[/gold] card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_REFINEMENT.selectionScreenPro: Choose an [gold]Innate[/gold] card to put into your hand.
ARISTOCRAT_PARRY.title: Parry
ARISTOCRAT_PARRY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each enemy that intends to attack.
ARISTOCRAT_BESTOW.title: Bestow
ARISTOCRAT_BESTOW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Next turn, draw [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] additional card(s).
ARISTOCRAT_BORN_RULER.title: Born Ruler
ARISTOCRAT_BORN_RULER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next [gold]Perk[/gold] card you play triggers its [gold]Perk[/gold] an extra time.
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_HAND.title: Golden Hand
ARISTOCRAT_GOLDEN_HAND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies [blue]X[/blue] times.
Apply [blue]X[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]X[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Gain [blue]10X[/blue] Gold.
ARISTOCRAT_LAST_RESORT.title: Last Resort
ARISTOCRAT_LAST_RESORT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] times.
Whenever this card is discarded, its cost is reduced by [blue]1[/blue] for this combat.
ARISTOCRAT_LUXURY_DINING.title: Luxury Dining
ARISTOCRAT_LUXURY_DINING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Heal [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] HP.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Gain [blue]3[/blue] Max HP.
ARISTOCRAT_LUXURY_GOODS.title: Luxury Goods
ARISTOCRAT_LUXURY_GOODS.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose a [gold]Perk[/gold] card in your hand; it costs [blue]0[/blue] until played.
ARISTOCRAT_LUXURY_GOODS.selectionScreenP: Choose a [gold]Perk[/gold] card to make free.
ARISTOCRAT_MASTER_STRIKE.title: Master Strike
ARISTOCRAT_MASTER_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy intends to attack, set its [gold]Strength[/gold] to [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
ARISTOCRAT_PARDON.title: Pardon
ARISTOCRAT_PARDON.description:
Exhaust up to [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] cards in your hand.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_PARDON.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to exhaust or remove.
ARISTOCRAT_PRIDE_FORM.title: Pride Form
ARISTOCRAT_PRIDE_FORM.description: At the end of each turn, play a random [gold]Innate[/gold] card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and one from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_PURE_BLOOD.title: Pure Blood
ARISTOCRAT_PURE_BLOOD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Perk[/gold] card.
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Add a random Rare card to your deck.
ARISTOCRAT_RECOVERED_PROPERTY.title: Recovered Property
ARISTOCRAT_FREE_GIFT.title: Free Gift
ARISTOCRAT_FREE_GIFT.description:
Whenever you play a card with a [gold]Perk[/gold], draw [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] card(s).
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Enter a new shop.
ARISTOCRAT_GREAT_VAULT.title: Great Vault
ARISTOCRAT_GREAT_VAULT.description:
Spend [blue]10[/blue] Gold.
Choose [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] time(s): gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]; gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]; gain [blue]2[/blue] Energy.
ARISTOCRAT_VAULT_STRENGTH.title: Strength
ARISTOCRAT_VAULT_DEXTERITY.title: Dexterity
ARISTOCRAT_VAULT_ENERGY.title: Energy
ARISTOCRAT_PORTRAIT.title: Portrait
ARISTOCRAT_PORTRAIT.description:
Give [blue]{MagicNumber:diff()}[/blue] card(s) in your hand [gold]Retain[/gold].
[gold]Perk[/gold]: Permanently give [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck [gold]Innate[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_PORTRAIT.selectionScreenPromp: Choose a card to give [gold]Retain[/gold] or [gold]Innate[/gold].
ARISTOCRAT_REFORGED_BLADE.title: Reforged Blade
ARISTOCRAT_REFORGED_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Spend [blue]10[/blue] Gold to permanently increase this card's damage by [blue]{Increase:diff()}[/blue].
ARISTOCRAT_ROYAL_GUARD.title: Royal Guard
ARISTOCRAT_ROYAL_GUARD.description: The first [gold]Innate[/gold] card you play manually each turn is played twice.
